newsitem.title: UK: Brent Walker near sale of Pubmaster - report.
newsitem.headline: Brent Walker near sale of Pubmaster - report.

text.p: A group led by NatWest Ventures could emerge this week as the preferred bidder for Pubmaster, the public house chain owned by Brent Walker, in a deal worth over 165 million stg, the Sunday Times reported.
No one was immediately available at Brent Walker to comment.
The newspaper said NatWest was being supported by Prudential Ventures, HSBC Holdings and Bank of Scotland.
It said John Brackenbury, who stepped down as chief executive of Pubmaster, was thought to be lined up as a non-executive chairman of the NatWest group with an equity holding of some one percent.
Brent Walker said in May that it planned further disposals in its Pubmaster business during 1996.
The company has been struggling with huge debts and last week reported a half year pretax loss of 51.6 million stg and passed on its interim dividend.
